As a teacher, my goal will be to make all the processes easier for you. I understand a language as a system, so you just need to understand the logic of this system and then practice it.

We'll do lots of exercises, and of course practice lots of SPEAKING.
Also during our lessons I'm trying to reach the best balance between grammar, vocabulary, and reading.

It can be both formal and informal lessons.

For every formal lesson I prepare material for my students. I collect the best material from different textbooks, websites, and make it easier for you to understand. After the lesson I can send it so you'll be able to go through the material as many times as you need.

For informal lessons we'll speak on everyday topics or any specific topic by your choice. So focus will be on subjects where the student feels comfortable, to progress towards topics out of your comfort zone. After each lesson you'll have a list of new vocabulary and collocations for our topic.

As a result, you'll feel comfortable speaking Russian and massively improve it!

ALL levels are welcome!

pro_course_detail.title: RUSSIAN Speaking Club 🎙️
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lesson is for those who have already been learning Russian before (A2 level at least). We will focus on your conversational skills. Every single lesson we will talk a lot and discuss all the interesting topics you want to (can be anything - your hobbies, everyday life, traveling, literature, movies, cooking, culture differences, and so on). It’s going to be fun, just like a conversation with your Russian friend! If you already know the topic you want to talk about, please hit me with the message.

I’ll guide you patiently through the speaking process and we’ll make your speech more natural and correct. You’ll have a list of useful expressions and words at the end of every lesson. If necessary, I’ll correct your grammar as well.
We will master your Russian and get rid of the language barrier. Let’s start speaking!

!Note! For this type of lesson, you need to understand at least the basics of Russian language and be able to talk to me. If you are a beginner I’ll be very happy to see you at our Basic Russian Course.
If you want to discuss any particular type of language aspect, like grammar or pronunciation, please book Basic course.

本课程旨在帮助学员全面理解英语的基本语法概念，包括名词、动词、形容词和副词的用法，掌握简单句、复合句和复杂句的结构。学员将学习并运用常用时态，提高语法的准确性，理解主谓一致、代词用法和介词搭配等常见语法规则

【课程目标】
-初学者
-希望巩固基础的学生
-备考学生
-职场人士
-对英语感兴趣的成年人

【课程内容】
-基本语法规则：系统讲解名词、动词、形容词、副词等核心语法点。
-句子结构：学习简单句、复合句的构成，掌握句子基本结构。
-时态运用：深入理解常用时态的用法及其在句子中的应用。
-练习与应用：通过书面练习和口头表达，巩固所学语法知识。
-闪卡使用：利用闪卡帮助学生快速记忆新词汇，便于随时复习。
-同步造句练习：实时造句练习，课后句子自动同步，可随时复习。
-多媒体学习：结合视频和互动材料，丰富学习体验。
-定期评估：通过测验和反馈，帮助学生识别进步和改进空间。

【课程特色】
-系统性强：全面覆盖基础语法知识，帮助学生扎实掌握。
-实践导向：强调语法在实际交流中的应用，增强学习效果。
-足量练习：轻语法，重练习，在练习中发现不足。

pro_course_detail.title: ¡Aprende el idioma más hermoso del mundo conmigo!
pro_course_detail.description:
El español es sin lugar a dudas uno de los idiomas más importantes en la actualidad debido al alto porcentaje de la población mundial que lo habla, especialmente en zonas como América Latina y España. Se estima que las proyecciones futuras harán del español el lenguaje oficial hablado por más del 10 % de la población en el año 2050, colocándose así entre los idiomas más importantes junto al inglés o al chino. Uno de los elementos que hacen que el español sea tan popular es el hecho de que es hablado en casi toda América como consecuencia de la conquista española.
Conmigo aprenderás que todo en la vida se basa en retos y oportunidades de crecimiento; así que estaría demasiado feliz de hablar contigo y ayudarte a lograr todo lo que te propones en temas lingüísticos. ¡Anímate y nos vemos pronto!

pro_course_detail.title: Learn and speak the most important language in the world with me!
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi, my name is Cristian. Learning a different language can be hard, but it can also be a fun and rewarding experience. Although I am not a native English speaker, I can relate to students because I had to learn english when I was younger. When I first started learning english, it was a real challenge, especially pronunciation. I was so embarrassed to speak and I would never put my hand up in class because I was scared of making mistakes. Finally, I had a great teacher who taught me that making mistakes and learning from them is the best way to learn a language. He was right!

I have been teaching for 9 years now. Before teaching, I studied sports management at university. This background has helped me understand some of my students' cultural differences, including how they may approach learning, writing, body language, and speaking.
Teaching is a great profession that allows you to learn forever. While I teach students, they teach me about their cultures, lives, and other ways to see the world. It is a privilege to teach and I am thankful for all of my students over the years who have shared their stories, interests, and dreams with me.
